text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. I look forward to working 
with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

Today, in preparation for this year's 
Classic Triple Crown, we decided to watch 
video recordings of past races.

(Appearing on the screen is Tokai Teio. —A 
confident, cheerful Umamusume who looks up 
to Symboli Rudolf.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody can catch up to her! It's the 
undefeated Double Crown Umamusume, Tokai 
Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"A flexible body paired with an 
indomitable spirit. She achieved 
magnificent results in both the Satsuki 
Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations are soaring high for an 
undefeated Triple Crown victory!"

On the monitor, Tokai Teio was proudly 
flashing a peace sign.

Her supple form racing across the turf 
captivated everyone who laid eyes on her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So strong contenders like her were running 
on the stage of the Classic Triple Crown 
races.
choice_data_list: Did I end up putting pressure on you?
Did I put too much pressure on you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? No. Why would I be feeling "pressure" 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, that information is 
irrelevant to me.

After saying that with a puzzled look, 
Mihono Bourbon turned her eyes back toward 
the screen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inputting image from venue atmosphere, 
sense of speed, and race 
developments—complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge regarding the Classic Triple 
Crown has been acquired. Mental training 
is now possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With further stamina reinforcement and 
daily training, I will strive to achieve 
my goal.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to reach our goals!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. However, there is one problem.

Mihono Bourbon's expression clouds over 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As for the other order, I don't have a 
clear picture in mind yet.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's about "an Umamusume who gives people 
courage."

Indeed, I recall placing such an "order" 
before.

"The sight of you running has the power to 
give courage."

"‘The way you run has the power to give 
people courage.’"

"Please continue to prove from here on out 
that hard work can overcome talent."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —New objective added. Orders received.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her goal in the Twinkle Series: to achieve 
the Classic Triple Crown and prove her 
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Although received, the sensation known as 
"courage" is still not found in my 
database.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Consequently, I have no experience in 
either 'giving courage' or 'being given 
courage.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Unless you can grasp these experiences and 
sensations, fulfilling this order will 
prove exceedingly difficult.

Her face remained expressionless, but 
somehow, a disheartened aura radiated from 
her...

Wondering if there was any way to refresh 
my mood, I decided to—
choice_data_list: Let's come up with a new technique.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Searching for locations 
suitable for mochi pounding.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's mochi pounding event is being 
held in the shopping district today. 
Moving to the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ei, yah! Ei, yah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Oh! You've got real talent, young lady!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I am confident in my 
physical strength.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to join me, Master? 
Moderate exercise is optimal for 
refreshing oneself.

Perhaps pleased by the praise, Mihono 
Bourbon continued to participate 
enthusiastically in the mochi pounding 
after that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Switching to terrestrial 
broadcast.
(Beep—click)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Trouble detected. The television has 
turned off, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Proposing folk remedy. Shall we try 
smacking the television?"

After that, through one thing or another, 
the TV started working again on its own—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, what did that pun just now 
mean?

Mihono Bourbon had been observing the gag 
comedy routine with rapt attention.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order received. Devising new technique.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Judged that testing and practical 
application are essential for formulating 
this. Let us move to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...As an optional extra, I can also come 
up with special move names.

Afterward, Mihono Bourbon headed out to 
the grounds and worked hard until sunset, 
devising and mastering new techniques.

It seems she managed to get a nice change 
of pace. We can figure out that sense of 
"courage" in due time—

Together with Mihono Bourbon, I want to 
sprint through the Classic year together!
